title: Can LLM Agents Be Forward-Deployed Engineers? Requirement Discovery and Delivery for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2611.03551v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM coding agents can increasingly automate model post-training, but whether they can act as forward-deployed engineer (FDE) agents, discovering customer requirements and turning them into deployment decisions, remains unclear. We study this on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement: a simulated customer, grounded in the real use case's requirements, starts with an ambiguous request. An agent must discover acceptance criteria, data permissions, and hardware constraints in the discovery phase, then plan and execute a post-training recipe in the delivery phase. Across 15 models, the strongest discover over 80% of withheld requirements and open-weight models discover 40-50%; in the delivery phase, only 25% of runs across eight coding-agent configurations pass all acceptance criteria. translated_title: LLM智能体能胜任一线部署工程师吗？面向企业级文本到SQL的需求发现与交付
translated_abstract: LLM编程智能体日益能够自动化模型后训练流程，但它们能否胜任“一线部署工程师”这一角色——即发现客户需求并将其转化为部署决策——仍不明确。我们在一个真实的企业级文本到SQL项目场景中对此展开研究：一个基于真实用例需求构建的模拟客户，最初仅提出一个模糊的请求。智能体必须在发现阶段探索出验收标准、数据权限和硬件约束，然后在交付阶段规划并执行后训练方案。在15个模型的评估中，表现最强的模型能发现超过80%的隐藏需求，开源权重模型能发现40-50%；在交付阶段，八种编程智能体配置中仅有25%的运行通过了全部验收标准。我们识别出该场景中的四个瓶颈：（1）需求发现不完整，40%的隐藏需求缺失或被错误表述；（2）执行不可靠……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究在企业级文本到SQL的真实项目场景中评估了LLM智能体担任“一线部署工程师”的能力，发现即便最强的模型也只能发现约80%的隐藏需求，且各配置中仅25%的交付运行能通过全部验收标准，并总结出需求发现不完整等四大瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates LLM agents as forward-deployed engineers on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement, finding that even the strongest models discover only about 80% of withheld requirements and just 25% of delivery runs pass all acceptance criteria, identifying four key bottlenecks including incomplete requirement discovery.
